outsideUsa.question: Do you work with clients outside USA?
outsideUsa.answer: I work with clients worldwide. Projects are fully remote, and I use tools like Zoom and Slack to communicate and collaborate effectively. Payments are easy and secure through Stripe, so you can work with me from anywhere.

timeline.question: How long does a typical project take?
timeline.answer: It depends on the scope: {durations}. I always provide realistic timelines and meet them.

support.question: Do you offer post-launch support?
support.answer: Yes! Every project includes complimentary post-launch support. The duration depends on the service: {supports}. Support covers bug fixes, minor adjustments, and technical assistance. After that, the {maintenanceTitle} plan is {maintenancePrice} and covers security updates, performance monitoring, content updates and priority support.

technologies.question: Do you work with technologies besides Next.js?
technologies.answer: My specialty is the React/Next.js ecosystem with TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL - enterprise technology at small business pricing. I also have experience with vanilla JavaScript, and can adapt to project needs. I always recommend the best technology for each case.

payments.question: How does the payment process work?
payments.answer: Two payments: 50% to start and 50% when the project is delivered. The landing page and the maintenance plan can be paid directly on this site through Stripe. For everything else we agree on the scope and the final price first, and then you receive a secure Stripe payment link. Zelle is also accepted.

progress.question: Can I see progress during development?
progress.answer: Absolutely! I provide weekly progress updates and you'll have access to a staging environment where you can see real-time progress. I respond within 24 hours (usually much faster) to any questions or concerns. Transparency is key to my process.

What used to take hours now takes minutes. Randy's custom email campaign system is intuitive and exactly what we needed. Randy was professional, communicative, and delivered on time. He explained everything clearly and was always available. Highly recommend RC Web Solutions to any Houston business.
